name: University of Tennessee College of Medicine Program (UTHSC / Semmes-Murphey, Memphis TN)
program_length_note: 6-year program for classes entering through 2012 (graduates 2012-2018); 7 years from the 2013 entrants (first 7-year graduates 2020, no 2019 graduates). Site text said 'six-year ... two residents per year' through 2014, 'seven-year' from 2015-03.
complement_note: 2 per year through the 2018 entrants (3 in 2010 and 2017); 3 per year from 2019 (2 in 2021); 4 PGY-1s in 2026-27.

gap_details.2011-2012: No capture in this AY, but bracketed: GME list Oct 2008 and May 2013 plus alumni list account for every graduating 2006-2012 entrant; only a 2009-11 entrant leaving before May 2013 (or the pre-window leaver Duntsch staying past Jul 2011) could be missed, and every class then is 2 (3 in 2010) as in the complement.

gap_details.2025-2026: Semmes-murphey 2026-01-24 used; identical to uthsc 2026-04-11. Semmes 2025-09-17 was mid-update (no new interns, Wallace mislabeled).

alumni_note: Graduation years 2012-2026 inserted into training_history (28 rows). No 2019 graduates (6->7 year transition). Class of 2014 has only Berkeley Bate (2008 entry class of 1, or someone lost before the window). Phase 2: the GME lists show Bate was the only 2008 neurosurgery intern still present by 2013 (Oct 2008 Surgery-Preliminary list: Bate, Goodwin, Walls; Goodwin/Walls never appear on a neurosurgery list or paper), so the 1-graduate class of 2014 is not an in-window loss. Christopher Duntsch (on the 2008 lists, not on the alumni page) is absent from the May 2013 list; he left before or around the start of the window (public record: Dallas practice from July 2011).
